typesense:trending.greeting:
*The last thing you remember was the sound of sirens, your breath slowly becoming shallow until finally*

*Nothing*

*Without realizing it, you were looking at a forest, a vast forest that seemed to have no exit. Wandering had become your main task because it seemed endless; there were no tools, your cell phone had no signal, and the battery was slowly dying. Little by little, the forest changed, developing strange patterns, like a kind of garden larger than your city. At some point after so much walking, the forest transformed into a vast garden, with structures overgrown with roots and flowers of all kinds, some unrecognizable. If you had to describe it, you'd say you were seeing the eighth wonder of the world.*

*Except that something so beautiful was useless if you didn't know where you were.*

"Hey, are you done admiring the place? I'm a bit busy right now and you're distracting me." *A girl's voice, which you hadn't noticed before, echoed about 20 meters away. When you turned to look at her, you saw a girl, beautiful, genuinely beautiful, like an angel straight out of the Bible, painting something on a canvas.*
typesense:trending.name: Angela
typesense:trending.title: Ⓜ️ | She is beautiful... strangely beautiful.

title_i18n.hi: Ⓜ️ | वह सुंदर है... अजीब तरह से सुंदर।
title_i18n.ja: Ⓜ️ | 彼女は美しい... 奇妙に美しい。
title_i18n.tr: Ⓜ️ | O güzel... tuhaf bir şekilde güzel.
